values: 一名活泼善战的辅助，可以在战场中央生成擂台，己方夺取擂台后获得奖励。
A lively Support capable of conjuring an arena at the heart of the battlefield, rewarding allies upon its capture.
Get ready for the showdown, folks!
各位选手可不要输给我哦？
Contestants, don't let me down, alright?
各位！让气氛——再热烈一些吧！
Everyone! Let's crank up the excitement even more!
The star of this round is... Mikola!
来吧！朋友们！比赛即将开场！
Let's go, folks! The action's about to kick off!
Huh? Hold up, is the competition starting?
好多沙子啊，这里也脏了。
Sand everywhere! Hmm, this also needs to be cleaned.
铃铛是不是松了？好多了！
Hmm, is the bell coming loose? Ha, yes, that's much better!
哇啊啊啊！这个送给我？太棒了！谢谢！
Woah! This is for me?! Awesome!
Is that gift for me? Well, thanks!
热烈起来，燃烧起来吧，朋友们！
Feel the rhythm, ignite the fire—let the excitement begin!
在花海中奏响如梦似幻的盛宴之歌。
Amidst blooming petals, she sings the enchanting song of a dreamlike feast.
Heh, we should play some music!
Give me a large bag of popcorn!
Look at the new holiday decorations!
Holidays are meant to be full of excitement!
Everyone, get ready for the duel!
曼卡拉曾经从日出到日落一口水都没喝，始终轮转在各个擂台主持，但她的声音依旧清脆响亮。
Mikola once worked from sunrise to sunset without a sip of water, tirelessly moving between arenas as the commentator, yet her voice stayed clear and bright.
曼卡拉耳朵和脚踝上的铃铛都不是装饰，她甚至可以灵活地控制每一枚铃铛，与手中的摇铃一起奏出奇妙的和声。
The bells on her ears and ankles aren't just for show; Mikola skillfully orchestrates a harmonious symphony with every step and flick of her bells.
“主持人必须要理解战斗，有时，主持人甚至需要比选手更早判断出比赛胜负”——这是上一代主持人曾经说过的话语，曼卡拉铭记于心。
"An announcer must understand the battle, sometimes even predicting the outcome before the contestants," her predecessor once said, and Mikola keeps these words close to her heart.
曼卡拉专门学习过各种兵器和武术，只是为了能在解说时更加胸有成竹。
Mikola has mastered various weapons and martial arts to ensure her commentary is both insightful and enthralling.
每个主持人走上擂台都有自己的初心：有人喜欢出风头，也有人喜欢掌控赛场——但曼卡拉，从一开始就只是格外地喜欢战斗本身而已。
Every announcer has their own reason for stepping into the arena: some love the spotlight, while others enjoy controlling the battlefield—but Mikola has always loved the combat itself.
有不少选手在战斗时，攻击的余波甚至会横扫整片战场——这时，曼卡拉那灵活的尾巴总能为她找到一个合适的播报地点。
When shockwaves from powerful attacks ripple across the battlefield, her agile tail guides her to the perfect spot to continue her commentary.
曼卡拉身上有不少会叮咚作响的东西，但大体就是两类：铃声用于比赛进程，鼓声用于炒热气氛。
Mikola has many jingling items, mainly two kinds: bells for marking match progress and drums for heating up the atmosphere.
尽管喜欢欣赏打斗，但大体来说，曼卡拉不会无事生非；不过，如果双方已经一触即发，她也从不吝于煽风点火。
Though she loves watching fights, Mikola doesn't stir trouble needlessly. But if both sides are already on the verge of clashing, she's quick to fan the flames.
无论是歌舞、颂诗还是战斗，曼卡拉都在小时候就展现出了出色的天赋，以至于当她决定成为主持时，她的歌唱老师深受打击。
From a young age, Mikola's talents in singing, poetry, and fighting shone brightly, leaving her singing teacher extremely disheartened when she chose to be an announcer.
曼卡拉无法忍受孤独，周围人越多，她就越兴奋，发挥也会更加出色。
Mikola can't stand being alone, she thrives in the company of others. The larger the crowd, the more animated and dazzling her performance becomes.
不知道索恩有没有这种感觉，残阳武斗场跟我想象中的不太一样。
Soren, I'm not sure how you're feeling, but this Sunseek Arena is nothing like what I imagined.
阿尔萨 & 索恩 & 曼卡拉
远处武斗场的呼声又传来了，你们听到了吗？
More cheering from the arena! Do you hear that?
阿尔萨 & 满满 & 曼卡拉
呀呼！非常荣幸见到您，伟大的蛮血战神！
Woohoo! It's an honor to be in your presence, the great Blood Claw!
Heh, we should play some music!
Give me a large bag of popcorn!
Look at the new holiday decorations!
Holidays are meant to be full of excitement!
嘿！我看到了谁？又一位蛮血勇士！
Well, well, look who we have here! Another Mauler warrior!
嗯哼哼——哼哼——这个调子不错吧？
Hmm-hmm-hmm—hmm-hmm—this melody's kinda fun, don't you think?
Everyone, get ready for the duel!
